scope: Current factual task-level package for the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph edges only. It does not edit production data, duplicate existing Kourend transport, quest, farming, combat, or diary-utility records, assign a strategy score, infer player state, or generate a route.

included: quest, location, minigame, encounter, and skill gates
model-ready proposed actions and graph edges
excluded: kill, raid, crop, catch, charge, or daily-counter assumptions

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier; Elise claims the rewards in Kourend Castle's courtyard.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy diary skill requirements unless a task or its external access gate expressly requires an unboosted level. This package identifies known exceptions and otherwise records the diary convention rather than inventing a boost method.
global_rules.post_favour_current_state: Kourend favour and Architectural Alliance were removed on 10 January 2024. Do not add house-favour, favour certificates, Architectural Alliance, old minecart-station unlocks, or old house-specific access requirements to any current task. Current access is instead governed by the task's stated skill, quest, diary, item, or activity gate.
global_rules.observation_rule: A combat kill, raid completion, crop state, crop harvest, fish catch, dynamic library book, talisman drop, totem-piece drop, daily claim, charge count, and minigame output is never inferred. The relevant task milestone is added only after player-confirmed completion.

existing_normalization_reference.boundary: Future integration must reference these records/actions where their subject overlaps. It may add the remaining diary task and tier-claim milestones, but must not create conflicting transport, memoir, farming, combat, POH, or Ash-sanctifier models.

proposed_normalization.action_shape: One action per unnormalized task, with completion requiring the task's own milestone and transitions restricted to known deterministic consumed inputs/fixed XP. Existing normalized diary utility actions must be referenced, not recreated.
deferred_choice_outputs: library Book of Arcane Knowledge experience choice

external_fact_edges: medium-enter-farming-guild and elite-make-battlestaff -> Farming Guild facts
all tier claims -> achievement-diary-utility and diary-task-utility-branches
post_favour_conflict_edges: No current action may depend on Kourend favour or Architectural Alliance.
Minecart use references lovakengj-minecart-network only; it is not a diary task gate.
A Kingdom Divided references its existing fact record and is not a diary task prerequisite.

integration_conflicts.current_fact: Favour and Architectural Alliance are removed. Older guide claims that any task requires house favour, minecart unlocks, the old Shayzien wounded-soldier task, or Architectural Alliance are stale.

integration_conflicts.topic: Memoirs and Book of the dead
integration_conflicts.current_fact: The medium task needs all five page destinations and one charge each; charge capacity/recharge is already modeled in Kourend memoir records and must not be duplicated.
Portable charged talisman and mounted POH talisman are valid alternatives. Current action:complete-kourend-hard-xerics-heart-teleport-task already captures that choice.
Protective footwear is required for the hard wyrm task before elite. Elite supplies permanent burning-effect immunity, but does not make combat success automatic.
Blessing utilities and the existing hard blessing/sanctifier actions already exist. Charges, daily allowances, chance effects, ash drops, and XP cannot be auto-applied.
